name: Moment of Darkness
body:
School evocation [darkness]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of coal dust)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 20-ft. sphere
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A 20-ft. radius sphere of darkness expands out from a point you designate. This short-lived darkness functions as the spell darkness, however, it is not powerful enough to dispel light.
